messages:
alex_ops: Quick heads-up: audit shows ~18% of reserved GPUs in eu-west dedicated pools were idle last 24h. Suspect fractional-reserve param is too loose.
priya_sre: Do we have query / raw numbers? CPU vs GPU? Which pools? 
ben_platform: Ran a query, pasted below:
```
SELECT pool, sum(reserved) as reserved, sum(used) as used, 100*(1 - sum(used)/nullif(sum(reserved),0)) as idle_pct
FROM cluster_allocs
WHERE region='eu-west' AND pool_type='dedicated'
GROUP BY pool;
```
ben_platform: quick results: pool-a reserved 120 used 92 idle 23.3%, pool-b reserved 80 used 74 idle 7.5%, pool-c reserved 60 used 46 idle 23.3%.
maria_cost: That ~18% idle maps to $12k/mo leakage on current committed contracts.
alex_ops: Two likely causes: over-reserving from tenant carveouts AND routing preferring reserved lanes even when underutilized. My proposal: implement "soft carveouts" — guarantee a small min_slots per-tenant but allow bursting beyond to shared until capacity pressure.
ben_platform: Rough config sketch for scheduler:
```yaml
soft_carveouts:
  - tenant: enterprise-1
    min_slots: 8
    burstable: true
    burst_limit_pct: 40
  - tenant: startup-x
    min_slots: 2
    burstable: true
    burst_limit_pct: 30
```
sam_eng: Routing policy idea: prefer reserved if tenant current_used < min_slots, otherwise allow shared with lower priority. Also add a preempt window to reclaim burst slots under pressure.
priya_sre: Need telemetry and alerting too: add metric reserved_slot_overhang and alert when >10% for 6h. Also instrument preempt latency (p99 preempt delay).
alex_ops: Canary plan: enable soft-carveouts in eu-west-c only for 48h. Track slot_utilization_by_tenant, reserved_slot_overhang, and invoice_delta. If idle falls <12% and preempt latency ok, expand to eu-west-b.
maria_cost: Finance wants a daily carveout_vs_usage delta exported to billing so we can attribute wasted reserved capacity per-tenant.
ben_platform: Quick experiment suggestion: set burst_limit_pct=25 for enterprise-1 in eu-west-c now and observe for 24h. Anyone object?
sam_eng: +1. I'll gate behind a feature-flag and roll to canary. Will push scheduler v2.13-rc with ff:soft-carveouts.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: started rollout of scheduler v2.13 to eu-west-c canary (ff:soft-carveouts) at 2024-03-12T10:22Z
priya_sre: If after canary preserved idle >12% tighten burst_limit_pct or reduce min_slots. Also validate eviction order and SLA impact.
alex_ops: I'll draft an RFC and a short runbook (how to rollback, who to page). Action items: ben run query hourly and dump to /tmp/alloc-audit, sam deploy canary, priya add alert + dashboard, maria wire billing delta to daily exports. Thanks :thumbsup:
ben_platform: I created a starter dashboard: /dashboards/allocations/soft-carveouts
sam_eng: Will post canary telemetry here, keeping pings minimal.
alex_ops: Closing loop in 72h, will follow up with the RFC link in this thread.
